details: Global financial markets have experienced a "relief rally" following indications from U.S. President Donald Trump that peace negotiations with Iran are entering their "final stages" or are "in progress." This optimism has led to a significant unwinding of geopolitical risk premiums, causing crude oil prices (both WTI and Brent) to plummet by approximately 5%. Stock markets, including major U.S. indices, have rallied as investors embrace a "risk-on" sentiment. This de-escalation suggests a reduced threat of immediate military conflict and potential disruptions to critical oil shipping routes like the Strait of Hormuz.
title: US-Iran Peace Talks Advance, Sparking Global Market Rally and Oil Price Drop

details: Despite reports of progress in US-Iran peace talks, significant disagreements persist. Iran's Supreme Leader has insisted on retaining Tehran's enriched uranium reserves, and disputes remain over a proposed toll system for vessels transiting the Strait of Hormuz. U.S. Secretary of State Marco Rubio stated that any tolling arrangement in the waterway would derail negotiations. These ongoing points of contention introduce an element of caution amidst the broader market optimism.
title: Iran Remains Divided on Key Issues in US Talks, Including Uranium and Hormuz Toll
